what.heading: What Apercura does
body: Apercura publishes a page for every doctor, dentist and midwife registered in France, built from the national register of health professionals and other public open data.

Patients find any practitioner, not only those who pay a platform. Practitioners can claim their page for free, check it and complete it. Free online booking, without a patient account, will open later.

principles.heading: Principles
list: Every practitioner is listed the same way, whether or not they use Apercura.
Factual information only: no ratings, no reviews, no ads and no paid ranking.
Free for practitioners and patients, with no subscription and no commission.
Each page shows where its facts come from and when they were last updated.
Minimal data, collected for a stated purpose and deleted on schedule.

how.heading: Where the pages come from
body: Pages are generated each week from the Annuaire Santé of the Agence du numérique en santé, the FINESS register of establishments and the Assurance Maladie directory. The data page lists every source, its licence and its date.

who.heading: Who runs Apercura
body: Apercura is a public-interest project. It is not a government service and is not affiliated with the Assurance Maladie, the Ordres or the Agence du numérique en santé.

rules.heading: Which practitioners have a page
body: A practitioner has a public page when the register lists them with at least one activity open to patients (a practice, a health centre or a hospital) at an address. People without a fixed place of practice keep a record they can claim, but no public page.
Pages show facts only, in a neutral order: there are no ratings, no reviews and no paid ranking.

correct.heading: Correcting an error
body: Most facts come from registers kept by others, so the lasting fix is made at the source. The page follows at the next weekly import.
list: Name, profession, specialty, place of practice and phone: the practitioner updates their registration with their Ordre (or the body that registered them in the RPPS).
Agreement sector, OPTAM and Carte Vitale: they come from the Assurance Maladie directory (ameli.fr).
Name and address of an establishment: they come from the FINESS register, kept by the regional health agencies.
Practitioners can also claim their page from the practitioners’ area, then complete it and correct what is shown.

remove.heading: Objecting to a page
body: Under article 21 of the GDPR, a practitioner can object to the publication of their page. Apercura publishes the directory on the basis of a legitimate interest: informing the public from public data.

An unclaimed page will be hidden as soon as the request is received, then deleted after a light check of the request. A claimed page can be removed by its holder at any time. Once removed, a page does not come back with the next import.

AccessibilityPage.title: Accessibility
AccessibilityPage.lead: Apercura is designed for everyone, including older and low-vision people. This statement says where it stands: a self-assessment is done, the full audit is in progress.

commitment.heading: Commitment
body: The publisher of Apercura is committed to making the site accessible. It aims to conform to the French accessibility framework (RGAA 4.1) and to WCAG 2.2 level AA on every page.
Patient pages use body text of at least 18 px, targets of at least 44 px, a visible focus, and nothing on them relies on colour alone.

status.heading: Compliance status
body: The site partially conforms to RGAA 4.1. This status rests on a self-assessment and on automated tests, not yet on a full audit: the conformance rate will be published at the end of the manual audit, which is in progress.
This statement is interim. It will be completed after the audit, with the list of non-conforming content.

tests.heading: What was checked
list: Automated axe-core checks (WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 rules, levels A and AA) on every page type and every booking step, at every release.
Keyboard-only journeys with a visible focus: search, booking, the practitioners’ agenda.

Journeys read by a virtual screen reader: home, results, a practitioner’s page, every booking step, the appointment page, the day and week agenda (headings, regions, fields read with their label, announcements).
Display at 390 px wide without horizontal scrolling, checked on the pages that needed it.
Lighthouse accessibility scores of the home page, a practitioner page and a listing.

pending.heading: What remains to be checked
list: A manual pass with the VoiceOver (macOS and iOS) and NVDA (Windows) screen readers.
The audit of the 106 RGAA criteria on a representative sample of pages.
The results map: it complements the results table, which holds the same information, but it is not evaluated yet.

technologies.heading: Technologies used
body: HTML, CSS, WAI-ARIA and JavaScript. Search and the directory pages also work without JavaScript. Automated tests use Chromium; VoiceOver with Safari and NVDA with Firefox will be tested during the audit.

body: If you cannot access some content or a service, write to us at the address below: we will offer you an alternative and fix the page.

PrivacyPage.metaDescription: Data processed by Apercura, purposes, legal bases, retention, recipients, cookies and your rights, including objection.
PrivacyPage.title: Privacy
PrivacyPage.lead: Apercura collects as little as it can. This policy says what data is processed, why, for how long, by whom, and how to exercise your rights. The French version is binding.

roles.heading: Who is responsible
body: For the public directory, practitioner accounts, error reports and removal requests, the publisher of the site is the data controller.

For online appointments, each practitioner is the controller of their patients’ data. The publisher processes it on their behalf, as a processor, under the processing agreement included in the practitioner terms (GDPR article 28).

practitioners.heading: Directory: data about practitioners
body: Data: last name, first name, title, RPPS number, profession, specialties and skills, places and modes of practice, published phone numbers, conventionnement sector, OPTAM membership and Carte Vitale acceptance. A practitioner who claims their page can add their hours, fees, languages, a photo and a presentation.
Sources: the Annuaire Santé of the Agence du numérique en santé, the FINESS register and the Assurance Maladie directory, reused under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 and refreshed every week.
Purpose: letting the public find a health practitioner, where they practise and how to reach them. Legal basis: the legitimate interest of informing the public from public data (GDPR article 6.1.f).

Retention: as long as the practitioner is listed in the public registers. An unclaimed page disappears after two weekly updates in which the practitioner is no longer in the register; a page removed after an objection is never published again.
Information: writing to every practitioner would take a disproportionate effort (GDPR article 14.5.b). They are informed by the data page, a notice on every page and this policy.

accounts.heading: Practitioner accounts and claims
body: Data: email address, name, password (stored hashed), second authentication factor, Pro Santé Connect identity, supporting documents sent to claim a page, team members, and the log of access to patient data.

Purposes: managing the account, checking that a page is claimed by the right practitioner and protecting access to patient data. Legal bases: performance of the terms of use (article 6.1.b) and the legitimate interest of securing the service (article 6.1.f).
Retention: the account is kept until it is deleted; supporting documents, encrypted, are erased 30 days after the decision; the access log is erased after one year.

patients.heading: Appointments: data about patients
body: Data: first name, last name, email address, phone, whether it is a first visit, the reason chosen among the practitioner’s, date and time of the appointment. The practitioner may ask for less; no patient account is created.

Purposes: booking the appointment, sending the confirmation code, the confirmation and the reminder, and letting the patient cancel or move it. The practitioner, as controller, sets the legal basis; this data is health data (GDPR article 9).
Protection: this data is encrypted at the application level, with a key of its own for each practice, and every reading is logged. Emails contain neither the specialty nor the reason.
Retention: an unconfirmed booking is erased after 24 hours; the data of an appointment is erased 90 days after its date by default (30 to 365 days, as the practitioner sets it).

reports.heading: Error reports and removal requests
body: Data: the message, the contact email address when one is given and, for a removal request, the page concerned. Free text is encrypted.

Purposes: correcting reported errors and applying objections. Legal bases: the legitimate interest of publishing accurate information (article 6.1.f) and the right to object (article 21). Retention: the time needed to handle the request, then a report is deleted 6 months after it is closed and a removal request one year after its decision; after an objection, only the RPPS number of the page is kept, so that it is never published again.

“I am this practitioner” requests: the name, the professional email address, the phone number when given, the message and the page concerned, encrypted. Purpose: helping a practitioner who cannot claim their page online. Legal basis: the legitimate interest of keeping the directory up to date with the practitioners concerned (article 6.1.f). Retention: 12 months after the last exchange.

security.heading: Security and technical data
body: Practitioner sessions record a truncated IP address (the network, not the device) and the browser used, to protect their account. To limit abuse, the site transforms IP addresses with a keyed function before counting them, and never stores them as such; each counter is deleted once its window (a minute to a day) has elapsed. The host keeps its own technical logs under its contract.

recipients.heading: Recipients and processors
body: Data is neither sold nor rented, and is never used for advertising. Only these receive it, each for its own part: the publisher’s team (with no access to patient data), the practitioner and their team for their appointments, and the processors below.

Maps are loaded from a tile server (OpenFreeMap by default), which receives the visitor’s IP address like any website does, but no account or appointment data. Signing in with Pro Santé Connect goes through the Agence du numérique en santé.

transfers.heading: Transfers outside the European Union
body: None: all data, health data included, is hosted and processed in the European Economic Area and is not transferred outside it. Any change of processor will be announced here before it takes effect.

transfersHds.heading: Transfers outside the European Union
body: None: data is hosted and processed in the European Economic Area, and health data in France. Any change of processor will be announced here before it takes effect.

cookies.heading: Cookies
body: Only cookies strictly necessary to the service are set: the session of signed-in practitioners, the chosen language, and a cookie that limits a booking in progress to one browser (24 hours). No advertising or audience measurement cookies, no trackers: no consent banner is needed.

Statistics of claimed pages: each view adds one to the page’s total for the day, with no cookie or identifier; no IP address and no browser is recorded, and browsers that ask not to be tracked (Global Privacy Control, Do Not Track) are not counted. Only the page’s holder sees these totals, kept 13 months.

rights.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict its processing and to receive it in a portable format, object to its processing, and set directives on what happens to it after your death. Practitioners can export their account data from their space.

Write to the address below. For an appointment, preferably contact the practitioner, who is responsible for that data; if you write to us, we forward the request to them. You will get an answer within one month.
If you believe your rights are not respected, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

objection.heading: Objecting to a directory page
body: A practitioner can object to the publication of their page without giving a reason. If the page is unclaimed, a form is enough: it is hidden at once, then deleted after a light check, and the updates never publish it again. If it is claimed, only its holder can remove it, from their space.

changes.heading: Updates to this policy

TermsPage.title: Terms of use
TermsPage.lead: The rules for using Apercura, for patients and for practitioners alike. The French version is binding.

service.heading: The service
body: Apercura is a free directory of health practitioners registered in France, built from public open data, with free online booking for the practitioners who open it. It is published by the entity named in the legal notice.
Using the directory or booking an appointment requires no account. Using the site means accepting these terms.

content.heading: What the pages contain
body: Pages show factual information from public registers, in a neutral order. They carry no ratings, reviews, advertising or paid ranking.
The information may contain errors or be out of date: check it with the practitioner before you go. Every page says how to report an error.

fees.heading: Fees and conventionnement
body: Pages state the conventionnement sector and OPTAM membership as the Assurance Maladie publishes them, and link to ameli.fr to check them. Bookable pages also show the regulatory notice required by the order of 30 May 2018 (article 5).
The exact wording of that notice will be copied verbatim after the legal review: until then, it appears below as a field to fill in.

booking.heading: Booking an appointment
body: An appointment is confirmed with a code sent by email. Depending on the practitioner’s setting, it is confirmed at once or after they accept it. The link received by email lets you cancel or move it up to the deadline the practitioner sets.

Give accurate contact details and let the practice know if you cannot come. The times offered are the ones the practitioner publishes: the publisher guarantees neither their availability nor that the appointment takes place, which is the practitioner’s responsibility.

health.heading: Not medical advice
body: Apercura gives no medical advice and is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call 15 (SAMU) or 112.

practitioners.heading: For practitioners
body: Claiming a page and opening booking are free. Claiming a page requires proof of identity: Pro Santé Connect, the email address in the register, or a document checked by a person.

The practitioner is responsible for the information they add to their page. It must stay factual, fair and up to date, as the codes of professional conduct require; they state their fees and payment methods before opening their agenda.

For appointments, the practitioner is the controller of their patients’ data and the publisher their processor. The processing clauses of GDPR article 28 are annexed to the practitioner terms; they are being drafted and will be signed before appointments open.
The practitioner can export their account data and ask for the account to be closed at any time.

phone_callback.hint: Show it when you are at the practice, or give it to whoever answers its phone. Asking for a new one cancels the previous one.
phone_callback.codeHint: Keep it on screen or note it down: for your security we only show it now.
phone_callback.done: The phone callback confirmed the claim.

lead.open: Prove that you are this practitioner with one of the methods below.
lead.superseded: This claim was withdrawn after a contest.

outcome.verified: Pro Santé Connect confirmed your identity: your page is verified.
outcome.passed: Pro Santé Connect confirmed your identity. An administrator now reviews the claim.
outcome.mismatch: The Pro Santé Connect identity does not match this page's RPPS number.
outcome.error: Pro Santé Connect could not be reached or the sign-in was cancelled. Try again.
outcome.linkedElsewhere: This Pro Santé Connect identity is already linked to another Apercura account. Sign in with Pro Santé Connect to use that account.

documents.hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB at most. Up to 4 files.

review.title: Send for review
review.lead: An administrator checks your document and calls the practice. You receive the answer by email, within 48 hours on working days.

status.bookingDelay: Without Pro Santé Connect, the 7-day waiting period before online booking ends on {date}.
status.contestReview: This page already had a verified owner: an administrator decides, and Pro Santé Connect proves it fastest.

status.superseded: This claim was withdrawn after a contest
status.contestTitle: This page already has a verified owner
status.contestBody: An administrator will decide. Pro Santé Connect proves your identity fastest; the other methods need a document and a callback.

emailLink.title: Confirm the claim
emailLink.lead: This link was sent to the email address the national register publishes for a practice.
emailLink.invalidBody: It expired (it works for 24 hours) or was already used. The practitioner can send a new one from their claim.
emailLink.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait an hour, then try again.
emailLink.doneBody: The practitioner can now sign in to complete the page.
emailLink.body: If the practitioner of this practice asked to manage their Apercura page, confirm it. Otherwise close this page: nothing changes.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw this claim?
withdrawDialog.body: The claim closes for good: its proofs stop counting and its documents are deleted 30 days from now. You can open a new claim later, starting again from the verification.

Onboarding.title: Set up your page
Onboarding.lead: Three steps to a complete page for {name}.
Onboarding.publishFailed: The page could not be published. Try again in a moment.

check.label: Check the imported information
check.title: Check the imported information
check.lead: Your page starts from the national register (Annuaire Santé). Check your name, profession and places of practice.
check.registryNote: Something wrong? The lasting fix is made with your Ordre, which updates the register; the page follows at the next weekly import. You can hide a place or add one in the page editor.

booking.label: Opening hours and booking
booking.title: Opening hours and booking
booking.lead: Patients book on your page once your agenda is open. Before it can open, your page must state your fees and the payment methods you accept.
booking.deontology: A health professional who presents their activity online states their fees and the payment methods accepted (for doctors: article R.4127-53 of the public health code).
booking.settingsNote: Places, opening hours and appointment types are set in the booking settings.
booking.settingsLink: Set up opening hours and booking

publish.label: Publish
publish.title: Publish your page
publish.lead: Publishing shows your presentation, languages, fees and practical information on your public page. You can change or hide them at any time.
publish.already: Your page is published. Every change you save is online at once.
publish.shareLead: Let people know about your page: a link, a QR code and a waiting-room poster are ready.

Editor.title: Your page
Editor.lead: Complete the public page of {name}. Plain text only; what you hide is never shown.

empty.title: No page to edit yet
empty.body: Your page appears here once your claim is verified.

removed.title: Your page is removed from the directory
removed.body: Nobody can see it. You can restore it at the bottom of this page.

unpublished.title: Your content is not published yet

photo.title: Photo
photo.lead: Optional. A recent portrait, like an identity photo.
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB at most. We crop it square and remove its metadata (location, device).

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.lead: Factual information only: no testimonials, no comparisons (R.4127-19-1).
presentation.headline: Headline
presentation.headlineHint: One line under your profession, {max} characters at most.
presentation.bioHint: Plain text, {max} characters at most. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.

fees.title: Fees and health insurance
fees.lead: Required before online booking can open: your fees and the payment methods you accept.
fees.ameliPrefill: Prefilled from the Assurance Maladie directory. Your statement replaces it on your page.
fees.noteHint: For instance what extra fees depend on.
fees.requiredHint: Booking stays closed until at least one fee and one payment method are stated.

contact.title: Website and phone
contact.websiteHint: Your practice's site, starting with https://
contact.showPhoneHint: Hidden, the page no longer offers to call the practice.

failure.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
failure.invalid: Some fields need a correction: see the messages under them.
failure.lastSite: At least one place must stay shown: a page without a place cannot be published.
failure.unknownPlace: We do not know this postcode and town. Check them.
failure.badPhone: This phone number is not valid.
failure.photoTooLarge: This photo is larger than 5 MB.
failure.photoUnsupported: This file cannot be used as a photo: send a JPEG, PNG or WebP.

Editor.saved: Saved. Your public page is up to date.
Editor.savedDraft: Saved. Publish your page to show it.

sites.title: Places of practice
sites.lead: Choose which places your page shows. Places from the register can be hidden, not edited.
sites.registryNote: A registry place is wrong? Your Ordre corrects it in the register; the page follows at the next import.
sites.name: Name of the place
sites.phoneHint: The practice's number, shown on the page.

remove.title: Remove your page
remove.lead: Your page disappears from the directory, searches and search engines, and does not come back with the next import. You can restore it here.
remove.action: Remove my page from the directory

issues.markup: Plain text only: no HTML, no links in brackets.
issues.range: The upper amount must be greater than the amount.
issues.website: This address is not a website (https://…).

claims.title: Claims
claims.lead: Claims waiting for a decision. Contests come first.
claims.queueHeading: {count, plural, one {# claim waiting} other {# claims waiting}}
claims.emptyBody: Claims sent for review appear here.

claim.title: Claim of {name}
claim.contestTitle: Contest: this page already has a verified owner
claim.contestPsc: The current owner was verified with Pro Santé Connect: only a claim verified with Pro Santé Connect can take the page over.
claim.contestBody: Approving gives the page to this account: the current owner's account is frozen and loses access to the practice.
claim.auditNote: Opening a document decrypts it and is recorded in the audit log, with your account and the time.
claim.phoneLead: Call one of these numbers from the register, never a number given by the claimant. Ask whoever answers for the code shown in the claimant's space.
claim.noCode: The claimant has not displayed a code yet.
claim.decisionLead: Approving verifies the page, creates the practice with the claimant as owner and emails them. Rejecting emails them the reason.
claim.codeHeard: Code read out by the practice
claim.codeLocked: Too many wrong codes: the claimant must show a new one.
claim.notApprovable: Approval needs Pro Santé Connect, the registry email, or a document and a successful phone callback (Pro Santé Connect in a contest against an owner verified with it).
claim.reasonHint: Say what is missing or wrong, plainly.
claim.decisionFailed: The decision could not be recorded. Reload the page and try again.

reports.title: Reports and removals
reports.lead: Removal requests (GDPR art. 21) and error reports sent from the public pages.
reports.failed: The action failed. Reload the page and try again.
reports.auditNote: Reading a request decrypts it and is recorded in the audit log.
reports.rejectReason: The request could not be confirmed.

contacts.title: “I am this practitioner” requests
contacts.lead: Practitioners who cannot claim their page online. Answer from your mailbox, then record where the request stands.
contacts.failed: The action failed. Reload the page and try again.
contacts.auditNote: Reading a request decrypts it; this is written to the audit log. Requests are deleted 12 months after their last change.
contacts.caption: Contact requests

Gdpr.rppsHint: 11 digits, printed at the top of the page.

errors.tooMany: Too many requests from this connection. Try again in an hour.
errors.notFound: No page has this RPPS number.
errors.claimed: This page is managed by its practitioner: only they can remove it, from their space.
errors.invalid: Check the form: a field is missing or too long.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

report.title: Report an error
report.lead: Tell us what is wrong on this page. Your message is encrypted and read by the Apercura team only.
report.doneTitle: Thank you, your report was received
report.doneBody: We check it. Facts from the register are corrected at the source; we tell you if you left an address.

kinds.impersonation: Someone is using this page in the practitioner's name

report.messageHint: What is wrong and, if you know, what is right.
report.privacy: Do not include any health information.

removal.metaTitle: Ask for the removal of a page · Apercura
removal.title: Ask for the removal of this page
removal.lead: Under article 21 of the GDPR you can object to the publication of your page. It is hidden as soon as we receive the request, then deleted after a light check.
removal.doneBody: It is no longer shown, indexed or listed. We check the request and answer by email within one month at most. Once it is confirmed, the page is deleted for good and does not come back with the register updates.
removal.contactHint: To confirm the request with you. It is encrypted and used for nothing else.
removal.messageHint: Anything that helps us check the request.
removal.confirm: I am the practitioner of this page
removal.privacy: A deleted page does not come back with the next import of the register.
removal.claimedTitle: This page is managed by its practitioner
removal.claimedBody: Only its holder can remove it, from the page editor of their space: the page then disappears at once and does not come back with the register updates.
removal.claimedLink: Remove my page from my practitioner space
removal.alreadyTitle: A removal request is being checked

contact.title: I am this practitioner
contact.lead: You cannot claim your page with Pro Santé Connect, the register email or a document? Leave us your details: a member of the Apercura team gets back to you to check your identity and help you.
contact.patientsTitle: This form is for the practitioner of this page only
contact.patientsBody: It is not for booking an appointment or reaching the practice: use the contact details on the page for that.
contact.claimFirst: With a CPS or e-CPS card, or access to the email published in the register, claiming is quicker:
contact.rppsHint: The one of the page you came from. It cannot be changed.
contact.name: Your full name
contact.emailHint: To answer you. We also send you an acknowledgment.
contact.phoneHint: If you would rather be called back.
contact.messageHint: Tell us why claiming online does not work for you.
contact.privacy: Your details and your message are encrypted, read only by the Apercura team to answer you, and deleted 12 months after the last exchange. Do not include any health information.
doneBody: A member of the Apercura team gets back to you by email or phone to check your identity, then helps you claim the page.
An acknowledgment has just been sent to the address you gave.
contact.claimedTitle: This page is already managed by its practitioner
contact.claimedBody: Its holder was verified. If this is your page and you no longer have access to it, open a claim: the team reviews it.
contact.withheldBody: A removal request is being checked.

errors.claimed: This page is already managed by its practitioner: open a claim.

noPractice.title: No agenda yet
noPractice.body: The agenda opens once your page is claimed and verified, or once a practice adds you to its team.

noCalendar.title: No place set up yet
noCalendar.bodyOwner: Set up the place where you see patients: opening hours and appointment types.
noCalendar.bodyStaff: The owner of the page has not set up the agenda yet.

requests.heading: Requests to answer
requests.lead: Patients wait for your answer. Unanswered requests lapse at the time shown.
requests.approved: Request accepted. The patient receives a confirmation.
requests.declined: Request declined. The patient is told by email.

week.title: Agenda
week.keyboardHint: Arrow keys move through the week, Enter adds or opens, Page Up and Page Down change the week.

add.title: Add to the agenda
add.emailHint: The first email only asks the patient to confirm this address. Details follow once confirmed, so a typo never sends them to a stranger.
add.taken: This time is already taken. Choose another time.
add.invalidEmail: Enter an email address such as name@example.fr, or leave it empty.
add.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number such as 06 12 34 56 78, or leave it empty.
add.endBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
add.outsideHours: Outside the opening hours: you can still add it.
add.addressHint: Only the practice sees it: emails to the patient never carry it.
add.invalidAddress: Enter both the address and its commune, or neither.

entry.messageHint: Sent with the cancellation email, if the patient confirmed their address.

block.title: Block a time slot
block.lead: A meeting, an absence: patients cannot book this time.

settings.title: Booking settings
settings.lead: Places, opening hours, appointment types and the rules of online booking.

ownerOnly.title: Only the page owner sets up booking
ownerOnly.body: Your role lets you run the agenda. Opening hours and booking rules are set by the owner of the page.

gate.heading: Online booking
gate.ready: Your page meets the conditions: you can open online booking.
gate.fees: State your fees on your page.
gate.paymentMethods: State the payment methods you accept on your page.
gate.waitingPeriod: Your page was verified without Pro Santé Connect: booking can open on {date}.
gate.noType: Offer at least one appointment type online.
gate.noHours: Add opening hours or an extra opening.
gate.deontology: A health professional who presents their activity online states their fees and the payment methods accepted (for doctors: article R.4127-53 of the public health code).
gate.opened: Online booking is open. Patients can book on your page.
gate.paused: Online booking is paused. The agenda still works for the appointments you add.

places.heading: Places
places.lead: Each place has its own agenda, in the time zone of its department.
places.noZone: Unknown department: this place cannot take bookings yet.
places.presetsNote: It starts with the usual appointment types of your specialty: {names}.
places.none: No place of your page can take appointments. Add your practice address in the page editor.
places.addPlace: Add a place in the editor

types.heading: Appointment types
types.lead: Prefer neutral names: the type of an appointment can reveal health information.
types.name: Name
types.travelHint: Kept free after each home visit, to reach the next patient or the practice, and before a visit that follows care at the practice or a block. Two visits in a row share one travel time.
types.areaLead: Patients choose their commune from this list before they choose a time.
types.areaEmpty: No commune yet: patients cannot book this home visit.
types.areaAround: Add the communes around the practice
types.areaAdded: {count, plural, =0 {No new commune.} one {# commune added.} other {# communes added.}}
types.areaNotLocated: The practice has no position on the map: add the communes one by one.
types.areaRequired: Choose at least one commune to offer this home visit online.
types.invalidDuration: Enter a whole number of minutes, from 5 to 480.
types.invalidMinutes: Enter a whole number of minutes, from 0 to 240.
types.invalidRadius: Enter a whole number of kilometres, from 1 to 50.

rules.heading: Weekly opening hours
rules.lead: The times patients can book, day by day. Several ranges per day are fine (a lunch break, for example).
rules.copyFor: Copy to the other weekdays, from {day}
rules.copied: {day} copied to the other weekdays. Save to apply.
rules.invalid: On {day}, each range must end after it starts and not overlap another.

exceptions.heading: Closures and extra openings
exceptions.lead: Holidays, an absence, or an extra morning: they win over the weekly hours.
exceptions.invalid: The end must come after the start.

booking.heading: Online booking rules
booking.minNoticeHint: Patients cannot book a time closer than this.
booking.horizonHint: How far ahead patients can book.
booking.step: Time between two possible start times (minutes)
booking.manualHint: Requests wait for your answer for up to 48 hours.
booking.askFirstVisit: Ask whether it is a first visit
booking.retentionHint: Between 30 and 365 days after the appointment. Apercura is not the medical record.
booking.instructionsHint: Plain text: the entrance, what to bring.

feed.heading: Private calendar feed
feed.lead: Follow this agenda in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Thunderbird. Anyone who has the link can read it: keep it to yourself.
feed.on: A feed link is active since {date}.
feed.urlHint: Shown only once: copy it into your calendar app now. Replacing it stops the old link.
feed.fullNames: Show patients’ full names in the feed
feed.fullNamesHint: Off by default: the feed then shows the appointment type and initials only, because your calendar provider’s servers read it.
feed.revoked: The feed is off: the old link no longer works.

log.title: Access log
log.lead: Each time patient details were decrypted: who, when, why and how many records. Nobody can change or delete it.

ownerOnly.title: Only the page owner reads the access log
ownerOnly.body: The access log of the practice is reserved to the owner of the page.

purpose.decrypt_volume: More than 500 records read within an hour

log.alert: On {date}, {name} read more than 500 patient records within an hour. Check that it was expected; if not, remove their access and change your password.

Team.title: Team
Team.lead: Invite the people who run your agenda. Each one signs in with their own account and a second factor.

ownerOnly.title: Only the page owner manages the team
ownerOnly.body: Ask the owner of the page to invite, change or remove a member.

roles.heading: Who can do what
roles.owner: Everything: the page, the team, the booking settings, the access log.
roles.practitioner: The agenda and the public page. Not the team, the booking settings or the access log.
roles.assistant: The agenda only: the day, the week, requests, appointments and blocks. Not the page, the team, the booking settings or the access log.

invite.heading: Invite someone
invite.sent: Invitation sent to {email}. It works for 48 hours.
invite.alreadyMember: This person is already in the team.
invite.rateLimited: Too many invitations today. Try again tomorrow.
invite.invalidEmail: Enter an email address such as name@example.fr.
invite.note: The invited person creates an account with this address, then sets up a second factor before joining.

members.heading: Members
members.removeBody: They lose access to the agenda at once. You can invite them again later.

other_address.title: This invitation is for another address
other_address.body: You are signed in as {email}. Sign in with the address the invitation was sent to.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations work for 48 hours. Ask {inviter} to send you a new one.

closed.title: This invitation is no longer valid
closed.body: It was withdrawn or already answered. Ask the practice for a new one if needed.

not_found.title: Invitation not found
not_found.body: Check the link in the email, or ask the practice for a new invitation.

errors.NO_SECOND_FACTOR: Set up a second factor before joining.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: You are already in this team.
errors.failed: Joining did not work. Try again in a moment.

Stats.title: Statistics
Stats.lead: Views of the page of {name}, its online bookings and what it still lacks.
Stats.noViews: No views counted in the last 30 days. Views are counted from the moment the page is claimed.
Stats.chartSummary: {total, plural, one {# view} other {# views}} in 30 days; the most: {max} on {day}.
Stats.dailyTableToggle: See the figures day by day
Stats.weeklyCaption: Views and online bookings per week
Stats.bookingsNote: Appointments patients booked online that week, whether they took place, were moved or were cancelled since.
Stats.checklistLead: {done} of {total}: page {score}% complete. A complete page helps patients know whether they can come.

privacy.counted: A view is counted when the page shows in a browser, with no cookie or identifier: no IP address, no browser and no visitor is recorded, only a total per day.
privacy.excluded: Robots and link previews are not counted, a visitor is counted once every half hour at most, and browsers that ask not to be tracked are not counted at all: the figures are an order of magnitude.
privacy.kept: Daily totals are kept {months} months, then deleted.

Stats.shareLink: Make the page known: the share kit
Stats.countedSince: Counted since {date}, the day your claim was verified: views from before are not shown to you.

Share.metaTitle: Share my page · Practitioner space · Apercura
Share.title: Share my page
Share.lead: The link to the page of {name}, its QR code, a waiting-room poster and a badge for your website.
Share.removedBody: It is no longer published: the link and the QR code lead to a missing page until you restore it.
Share.unpublishedTitle: Your page is not published yet
Share.unpublishedBody: The link leads to the register page, without what you added. Publish it so that patients and shares see your version.
Share.linkLead: For your email signature, your website or a message to your patients.
Share.copyFailed: Copying failed: select the text and copy it by hand.
Share.qrLead: Patients scan it with their phone camera to open the page. Files ready to print, black on white.
Share.qrHint: Keep the white margin around the code ({margin} modules) and print it at least 2 cm wide.
Share.badgeLead: A “Find me on Apercura” link to paste on your website. An image and a link, nothing else: no script, no cookie, no visitor tracking.
Share.badgeHint: Paste it into the page of your website where the badge should appear.
Share.posterLead: A page to print with your name and the QR code. It opens in a preview; print it from your browser.

poster.metaTitle: Poster to print · Practitioner space · Apercura
poster.title: Poster to print
poster.lead: Check the preview, then print. The poster is in French, the language of the patients who will read it.
poster.printHint: In the print dialog, choose the poster’s paper size and 100% scale, without headers or footers.

sheet.qrLabel: QR code to the practitioner’s page on Apercura
sheet.scan: Scan this code with your phone camera.
sheet.footFind: Address, phone number and practical information of the practice.
